description: This file defines the GuzzleHandler class used to send PSR-7-compatible HTTP requests using Guzzle 5 within the AWS SDK context, including request adaptation, promise handling, and error processing.

classes.name: GuzzleHandler
classes.description: A request handler class that sends PSR-7 requests using Guzzle 5, managing request creation, response adaptation, and error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HTTP client, defaulting to a new GuzzleHttp Client if none is provided.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method to send a PSR-7 request with options, returning a promise that resolves to a PSR-7 response or rejects with error data.

methods.name: createGuzzleRequest
methods.description: Creates a Guzzle 5 request from a PSR-7 request, applying options like delay, sink, and headers.

methods.name: createPsr7Response
methods.description: Converts a Guzzle 5 response to a PSR-7 response.

methods.name: prepareErrorData
methods.description: Prepares structured error information based on exceptions encountered during request handling.
